# Builds the vendored libusb (Linux subset) as a shared library named
# libusb1.0.so, matching the Android prebuilt's name. It stays a separate
# shared library on purpose: libusb is LGPL-2.1, and shipping it replaceable
# keeps the relink obligation satisfiable for app distributors.
#
# The caller wraps it in an IMPORTED LibUSB::LibUSB target (the name libuvc's
# FindLibUSB.cmake honors); a plain ALIAS would break libuvc's
# install(EXPORT), which cannot export foreign non-imported targets.
#
# Sources are the unmodified libusb release listed in SOURCE.md, reduced to
# the files the Linux backend compiles. config/config.h was generated by the
# upstream configure script with --disable-udev (hotplug uses netlink), so
# the library has no libudev dependency.

add_library(usb_vendored SHARED
  libusb/core.c
  libusb/descriptor.c
  libusb/hotplug.c
  libusb/io.c
  libusb/strerror.c
  libusb/sync.c
  libusb/os/events_posix.c
  libusb/os/linux_netlink.c
  libusb/os/linux_usbfs.c
  libusb/os/threads_posix.c
)

target_include_directories(usb_vendored
  PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/config"
  PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libusb"
)
target_link_libraries(usb_vendored PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
set_target_properties(usb_vendored PROPERTIES
  OUTPUT_NAME "usb1.0"
  POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON
)
